hotels.title: Stylish NSW Apartments on Wollongong Beach
hotels.description: Wake up to ocean-tinged air and the sound of waves crashing on the nearby beach at the boutique Adina Apartment Hotel Wollongong. Offering a central location in the vibrant regional city, the hotel is close to plenty of beachfront restaurants and cafés - the perfect snack stops while exploring the surrounding natural beauty. Dive into the heated swimming pool and indulge in the Jacuzzi and sauna, before heading off to see what quaint Wollongong has to offer. Immerse yourself in Buddhist and Hindu culture and architecture, head out on a day trip to the stunning Booderee National Park, or discover why Wollongong has a reputation for some of the best beaches in Australia.

hotels.title: Trendy Coastal Escape in the Heart of Wollongong
hotels.description: Lose yourself to the laidback lifestyle and coastal beauty of Wollongong with a stay at Hotel TOTTO, a sleek retreat in the heart of this surfy town. Discover the sun-kissed beaches and mingle with the trendy locals as you stroll along the beachfront promenade, dotted with cool cafes and lush green spaces. After days spent in the ocean and evenings spent dancing in tropical style beer-gardens, treat your tastebuds to an authentic wood-fired pizza at BASTA restaurant.

hotels.title: Wollongong Beachside Escape Just 90 Minutes from Sydney with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Escape to Sage Hotel Wollongong, a stylish seaside retreat on New South Wales’ scenic south coast. Just a 90-minute drive from Sydney, the hotel is surrounded by a plethora of beautiful beaches, coastal trails and all-terrain bike tracks. Contemporary design and thoughtful amenities make it the perfect base for immersing yourself in nature and discovering the South Coast’s highlights. Start each morning at The Five Islands Room & Terrace Restaurant with a relaxed breakfast, then set out for a day of adventure. Whether exploring winding coastal paths or cycling through lush landscapes, every moment offers a chance to connect with the region’s natural beauty. Return to the hotel in the evening to relax and recharge for the next day. Wollongong Beach lies just across the road, inviting you to sink your toes into soft sand or watch the waves roll in. For a refreshing dip, the 20-metre outdoor heated pool awaits, while Coldwater Creek Restaurant offers modern Australian cuisine to round off your day. Head into the hinterland or take a road trip to Lake Illawarra for added coastal charm.
